title: Teal Dreams
meta_description: Less than half a mile from the shimmering waters and sugar white sands, Teal Dreams awaits! This 3BDR 3BR home boasts all of the beachy vibe and modern comforts for your next 30A getaway.
description_expanded:
ABOUT THE HOME: Less than half a mile from the turquoise waters and the sugar white sands of Ed Walline State Park beach, Teal Dreams awaits! This charming Craftsman-style home is nestled amongst natural Florida foliage in a quaint neighborhood called the Cottages at Santa Rosa Beach. From fabulous restaurants and boutique shopping plus a grassy open area for live concerts, it's the quintessential beach town community. Teal Dreams' front porch greets you with a wonderful bench swing inviting you to enjoy your morning coffee with the salty breeze. Outdoor living in style continues on the back patio. Inside, the open floor plan living area is adorned with beachy accents and a sleek kitchen featuring stainless steel appliances. When it's time to rest, two bedrooms each boast a king bed and private ensuite bathroom, while a bunk room provides flexible sleeping arrangements for families and groups. A second living area upstairs allows plenty of space to spread out.

ABOUT THE AREA: Gulf Place was specifically designed to slow folks down with beautiful palm tree-lined streets, wide sidewalks, outdoor patios with large umbrellas, nature walking trails, plentiful green spaces, and park benches to sit and enjoy the views. This community features some of 30A's most popular restaurants, like Shunk Gulley and The Perfect Pig. Whether you are looking for an epic culinary experience, a fun feast for the whole family or just grab a quick bite to take to the beach, Gulf Place has it all.

BEACH ACCESS: This lovely home is 3 blocks from Ed Walline Public Beach Access. Hop on your bikes and take a stroll down to the beach!

ACCOMMODATIONS:
• Bedroom 1 -- King bed, Ensuite (1st floor)
• Bedroom 2 -- King bed, Ensuite (2nd floor)
• Bedroom 3 -- 2 Twin bunk beds (2nd floor)
• Full bathroom (2nd floor)

PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS:
• 3 Blocks to Ed Walline State Park beach access
• 2 bikes provided
• Two king bedrooms with private ensuite bathrooms
• Covered front patio with a bench swing and seating
• Back patio with outdoor seating area
• Outdoor grill
• Full size washer and dryer
• Full linen package: bedding \& bath towels, wash clothes, etc.
• Starter kit: toilet paper, paper towels, dishwasher and washing machine pods, trash bags, kitchen towels, bar of soap for shower
• Fully stocked kitchen

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: The Big Chill 30A, Gulf Place Plaza, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park A, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park, Alys Beach, Seaside Beach, Watercolor Beach

Home Truths:
- Unfortunately, pets are not allowed in this home. If undisclosed pets are brought into the home without AvantStay's approval, there is a fine of $500 per pet.
- Pack-n-play is available for use.

Parking Details:
- 2 parking spaces available in the driveway.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.

Bath: Travel-Sized Toiletries (Shower Gel, Shampoo, Conditioner, Soap)
